races.paceDynamic: Saisons d'Or will be the lone pace-setter from the outset, setting an uncontested lead with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure him. Hint Of The Jungle and Kamekist will track prominently in second and third, while the majority of the field - including English Lady, Fistral Beach, Split Elevens, River Wharfe, King Sharja, Ballybaymoonshiner, Reenie's Dream and Brother Dave - will sit back in hold-up positions. This creates a modest early gallop that will quicken from halfway as the large pack of hold-up horses fan out for their challenges. The race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll have every chance to close on a potentially vulnerable lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses time their runs effectively from halfway
scenarios.body: The modest early pace allows closers to position perfectly and overwhelm Saisons d'Or's uncontested lead in the final furlong. Multiple hold-up horses will hit the front simultaneously, creating a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hint Of The Jungle uses his prominent position to launch first from the pack
scenarios.body: His recent 7f wins and handy position behind the leader allows him to get first run on the field while others are still organizing their challenges. The move catches hold-up horses napping as they're forced to come from further back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds Gamely
scenarios.trigger: If Saisons d'Or utilizes the slow early pace to conserve energy for a strong finish
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old's experience allows him to dictate terms throughout, quickening just enough to maintain his advantage as the hold-up horses close late. His uncontested lead proves decisive in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rapid Early Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Saisons d'Or much earlier than expected, creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up a genuine staying test over the 7f trip. Late-closing stamina types benefit from the stronger gallop while speed horses tire.

watchPoints.text: Saisons d'Or may get too easy a lead early - watch if he's allowed to crawl through opening stages unchallenged
Hint Of The Jungle's prominent position could be decisive - monitor if he travels smoothly tracking the leader
English Lady and Fistral Beach both carry claiming riders - watch their positioning entering the home straight

races.paceDynamic: Arlington leads this field as the only genuine front-runner, having won three times at this course and distance when allowed to dominate early. Behind him, a cluster of prominent racers including Stash The Cash, Nad Alshiba Snow, and Marcus will track the pace, while the hold-up horses Man On A Mission and Invitorio find themselves with limited early speed to aim at. With Arlington likely uncontested early, he can dictate fractions and kick clear, but if he weakens late the prominent trackers get first run at him before the closers can wind up. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to Arlington to strike when he tires, as they'll get first bite before any hold-up horses can mount their challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Arlington Wire-To-Wire Win
scenarios.trigger: If Arlington gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina over this sharp 5f trip.
scenarios.body: His three course wins came from the front and he can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure, kicking clear in the final furlong. The hold-up horses have insufficient early pace to aim at and the prominent runners may wait too long to challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sit close enough to Arlington to pounce when he weakens in the final 100 yards.
scenarios.body: Stash The Cash or Nad Alshiba Snow can track Arlington's every move and have the tactical speed to strike first when he begins to tire. They get first run before any hold-up horses can organize their challenges from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Sweeps Up
scenarios.trigger: If Arlington sets too strong a pace early and the prominent runners also go too hard tracking him.
scenarios.body: Man On A Mission or Invitorio can pick up the pieces as the pace collapses, with their hold-up style perfectly suited to capitalize on a hot pace scenario. The front-runners and prominent racers pay for their earlier exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely falls apart and the main contenders cancel each other out through tactical errors.
scenarios.body: Marcus or Beneficiary can slip through as the principals get involved in pace battles or tactical mistakes. A messy race where positioning goes wrong for the favorites opens the door for a surprise.

races.paceDynamic: Shes Got A Brother and Queen Sana are both confirmed front runners who will clash from the start, creating an honest early gallop over this sharp 5f trip. Dance Of Angels and Dolo's Star will sit prominent to track the leaders, while the hold-up horses Society Kiss, Gwen Tennyson, and Magic Lady Mae face a disadvantage if the pace is too strong early. The dual front-runner setup should create a solid tempo that will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This race shape favours prominent runners who can track the pace without getting involved in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Shes Got A Brother and Queen Sana engage in a speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The early leaders will burn each other up over this minimum trip, allowing the prominent trackers to strike late. Dance Of Angels can capitalize from her ideal stalking position while Society Kiss may get a perfect late run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Shes Got A Brother dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Shes Got A Brother can establish a clear lead without serious pressure from Queen Sana
scenarios.body: The recent winner will control the tempo and kick clear in the final furlong, with Queen Sana battling on for second. Dance Of Angels will need to improve significantly to bridge the gap from her tracking position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly raced surprises
scenarios.trigger: If either Lavender Bloom or Reigning Queen show significant improvement from their debuts
scenarios.body: The newcomers from top connections could have been working exceptionally well at home and spring a surprise. Their lack of exposed form makes them dangerous if showing up with fitness and ability advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Queen Sana takes control
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana can dictate terms from the front while Shes Got A Brother settles behind
scenarios.body: The experienced leader will use her course experience to control the pace and find enough to hold off the challengers. Her consistent placed efforts suggest she's ready to break her maiden.

races.paceDynamic: Lednikov is the sole confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead from the gates, allowing him to dictate a comfortable gallop through the early stages. The prominent runners Night Bear, Artavian, and Electric Bass will settle just behind but lack the pace to apply serious pressure, while the bulk of the field including Jack Andrea, Arth's Gold, Spec Of Light, Eagles Whistle, Tupero and Shaffron are confirmed hold-up horses who will track towards the rear. With no pace pressure on Lednikov and a large contingent of closers needing to make up ground, the race will develop into a sprint finish where the leader gets first run but faces a wall of challengers. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader without getting too far back, as they'll have positional advantage over the hold-up brigade while avoiding reliance on an unproven front runner's stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lednikov Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov's stamina holds and he maintains his kick from the front.
scenarios.body: The veteran gets an uncontested lead and has enough left to repel late challenges, benefiting horses who can get closest to him early. Prominent runners get the best of the remainder by avoiding traffic issues that will plague the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainable or Lednikov weakens markedly in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Jack Andrea and Arth's Gold have the strongest late kick and class to reel in a weakening leader, with their recent C&D form giving them the edge. The strong pace collapse allows closers to unleash devastating finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Night Bear or Artavian can position perfectly and avoid the traffic that catches hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets the perfect stalking position and has enough pace to go by Lednikov while staying clear of the closing pack. They benefit from being close enough to strike but not relying on front-running stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov stops dramatically and creates a messy sprint finish with multiple horses challenging simultaneously.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where any horse with a clear passage can win, favoring those with the strongest recent form regardless of running style. Traffic and luck become decisive factors in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Charlie Darling will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, as most of this field are hold-up horses who prefer to come from behind. Fashionelle and Cold Henry may sit handy in second and third, but neither is keen to force the issue early. This creates a tactical nightmare for the eight hold-up horses including Payment Plan, Sullivan Bay, and Different Drum who will be bunched together seeking racing room in the straight. The sustainable early fractions and lack of pace pressure clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without effort.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Charlie Darling gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent form improvement.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to dictate terms completely, leaving the hold-up brigade with too much ground to make up when the sprint develops. His third place over course and distance last time shows he handles these conditions perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes

scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses are still trying to get organized and find clear racing room in the straight. The tactical advantage of an early position proves decisive in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens unexpectedly or traffic opens up perfectly for one of the back markers.
scenarios.body: Sullivan Bay or Payment Plan gets the dream run through a gap when it matters most, allowing their superior finishing kick to overcome the positional disadvantage. Their class edge shows when getting clear racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy sprint with multiple horses struggling for racing room.
scenarios.body: Apache Eagle or Regal Glory, drawn better or getting lucky in running, capitalizes when the fancied runners encounter trouble in a bunched finish. Form horses get hampered while an outsider sneaks through.

races.paceDynamic: Receipt and Shamacid will contest the early lead, with both showing confirmed front-running tendencies that should create an honest gallop from the start. The sustained pace battle between these two leaders will likely soften them up for the closers, particularly over this 7f trip where tactical speed becomes crucial. With five hold-up horses in the field including Phoenix Of Dreams, Wish This, Dapper Gee Gee, Cill Mocheallog, and Stoneywell, the weight of numbers favours those racing from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on the early pace battle and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace battle between Receipt and Shamacid is genuinely strong throughout the first 5f
scenarios.body: The front pair will tie up in the final furlong, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past with Phoenix Of Dreams and Cill Mocheallog best placed to benefit from their proven finishing kicks. Both have shown strong late pace and the setup plays perfectly to their strengths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Receipt or Shamacid can establish a clear early advantage without maximum pressure
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run on the field and maintains enough in reserve to repel late challenges, with Receipt's recent form edge giving him the better chance of lasting home. The hold-up horses find one too good despite their tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and the hold-up horses are caught too far back
scenarios.body: A horse able to track the pace without being part of the early battle gets the perfect run, with the leaders stopping and closers needing more time. This tactical position proves optimal in a moderately-run race with a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Receipt and Shamacid are unusually restrained early or one takes a clear uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a sprint where raw speed matters most, negating the hold-up horses' usual advantage. Cill Mocheallog's high TopSpeed rating could prove decisive in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Receipt and Shamacid both going forward early - if they engage in a genuine speed duel the pace will be strong throughout.
Phoenix Of Dreams has faded when prominent before so needs to be held up despite his recent good form.
Cill Mocheallog returning from 42-day break with new tongue-tie suggests breathing issues may have been a problem.
Dapper Gee Gee dropping back to 7f after struggling over 8f last time and has won fresh before.
Stoneywell carrying top weight and making his first appearance for new trainer connections after a 38-day break.
